services.desc: Skydive Cross Keys is located 100 miles south of New York City and is one of the closest skydiving centers to NYC. It takes roughly two hours to drive to our location from the city center. Each year, we complete over 20,000 skydives, making us the busiest skydiving facility in the Northeast! We’ve earned thousands of glowing Google reviews from happy jumpers across the country. Your safety is our top priority-fun is a very close second! If you are visiting the NYC area and don’t have your own transportation, we recommend that you either rent a car, or get an Uber or a Lyft ride. services.desc: Skydive Cross Keys holds a special place in the world of skydiving, one with a long and rich history. It opened its doors in 1994 when a small group of sports enthusiasts gathered around Cross Keys airport in Williamstown, NJ. Over the next two decades, it has become a true epicenter of the skydiving sport in the Northeastern region, hosting records, raising world champions, and advancing new disciplines. In the skydiving world, it’s always been known for its great vibe and a fun and supportive community. blurb: Skydive Cross Keys is the largest skydiving center in the region with high safety standards and a friendly atmosphere. Guests can make parachute jumps, schedule adventures, or join training for skydiving licenses. The facility includes parking, bathrooms, vending machines, shaded waiting areas, and souvenir options.
